html:
Augusto César Sandino was a Nicaraguan guerrilla leader who fought the United States Marines occupying Nicaragua from 1927 to 1933. He was murdered on the orders of Anastasio Somoza García in 1934.

A mechanic who had worked in Mexico's oil fields, he joined the Liberal side in the civil war of 1926. When the Liberal leaders made peace under American terms, Sandino refused and took his small army into the mountains of Nueva Segovia. The Marines, using aircraft, could not catch him, and he became a hero across Latin America.

When the Marines left he made peace, but the National Guard of Somoza seized and shot him after a dinner at the presidential palace. In 1961 young revolutionaries named their movement the Sandinista National Liberation Front after him. It took power in the revolution of 1979 in Nicaragua.
sum: Augusto César Sandino was a Nicaraguan guerrilla leader who fought the United States Marines occupying Nicaragua from 1927 to 1933. He was murdered on the orders of Anastasio Somoza García in 1934.
